text:
Casey: Anyone seeing a burst of client cert rejects in eu-central this morning? Appears right after the 02:45 IAM push.
Lin: Yes. TLS handshakes failing with unwrap errors. CloudTrail shows KMS Decrypt AccessDenied around 02:46.
Omar: I deployed a tightened key policy overnight to limit decrypts to known egress IPs (aws:SourceIp). I thought NAT egress IPs were stable.
Priyanka: That would explain it. Our proxy egress for eu-central goes through shared NATs which moved to a new IP after cloud infra refresh last week. If SourceIp is used, KMS will deny assumed-role requests from the new IP.
Casey: Sample log: `2026-04-02T02:46:12Z proxy-eu unwrap error: KMS:AccessDeniedException Decrypt denied for arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/proxy-keystore`. No VPC tag in the deny message.
audit-bot: Incident INC-2026-0789 logged and assigned to eng-security.
Lin: Short fixes: (1) Rollback the SourceIp condition on the key policy (fast). (2) Add the new NAT IPs to the allowed list (fast once IPs verified). (3) Switch to aws:SourceVpc or EncryptionContext-based guards (more robust).
Omar: Rolling policy revert now (revert-id r-2026-331). Will update when live.
Priyanka: In parallel, can we enable a 3-minute in-memory keystore cache? It would reduce outage surface while we confirm policy. We'll make it operator-only.
Casey: Be careful: cache-on-deny was turned off after silent-misuse incident. If we use it, keep it short and create alerts for cache-fallback usage.
Lin: Added temporary CloudWatch Logs Insights query to run from the SRE pager:
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, errorMessage
| filter eventName = "Decrypt" and errorMessage like /AccessDenied/
| parse userIdentity.arn as arn
| stats count() by arn, bin(1m)
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100
```
Omar: Revert applied at 02:48 UTC. Post-revert metrics show decrypt success rate returning to baseline.
Priyanka: Confirming TLS handshakes recovering in eu-central. Will watch for 60m.
Casey: For the post-incident: root cause = IP-based policy guard mismatched with dynamic NAT pool. Mitigations: (a) avoid SourceIp for service-to-KMS policies, prefer SourceVpc or EncryptionContext, (b) add CI lint rule that flags aws:SourceIp in KMS key policies, (c) add a deploy-stage smoke test performing a sample decrypt from each region's NAT egress.
Lin: I'll open PRs: TOOLING-945 (policy linter), INFRA-2233 (keystore short-cache operator flag + alert), ENGSEC-3699 (postmortem + runbook update).
Omar: Also propose emitting `iam.kms.policy.deploy{change_id=\"...\", author=\"...\"}` metric from the IAM pipeline so we can correlate denies with specific rollouts.
Priyanka: We'll add EncryptionContext keys `service` and `request_id` on decrypt calls so CloudTrail shows request-level detail. Makes mapping much easier.
Casey: Please add a checklist item to policy changes: verify egress IPs or prefer VPC/principal-based controls; notify eng-security channel pre-deploy.
Lin: Noted. Will add a preflight policy-emulation step that simulates denies for all known assumed roles.
Casey: Thanks everyone. We'll keep monitoring and schedule a short postmortem in 24 hours. :thumbsup:
